name: bookitLive
description_en:
bookitLive sells online scheduling for service appointments and group sessions. It is relevant when the same booking operation must represent a service, the resources that deliver it, and an available time.

Evaluate its limits in terms of configured services and resources, rather than assuming that unlimited bookings means unlimited configuration. This documentation profile distinguishes the booking experience from payment entitlement and the operating rules that determine when a slot can be sold.
description_zh:
bookitLive 提供面向服务预约和团体场次的在线排程。一次预约需要同时关联服务、交付资源和可用时间时，可以考察这套系统。

评估限制应看已配置服务与资源的数量，不能把预约次数不限理解为所有配置不限。本文依据文档区分预约体验、支付权益，以及决定哪些时段可售的运营规则。

sections.en:
Consider an instructor offering a repeating class and a separate private lesson. For the class, decide whether a customer reserves one place or books for a group; for the lesson, identify the instructor or room whose availability matters. The class page describes group bookings and notifications when a class booking changes.

A useful evaluation follows a new booking through payment, a changed participant count and a cancellation. Check the dashboard and the messages the customer actually receives. This is a suggested acceptance scenario, not a recorded execution. Decide your cancellation and refund policy before exposing paid places.
sections.zh:
例如，一位教师同时提供重复开设的班课和单独辅导。班课需要决定客户预约一个名额还是替团体预约；单独辅导则需确定由哪位教师或哪间教室的可用性控制。班课页面介绍团体预约及预约变化通知。

建议评估时跟踪新增预约、付款、参与人数变化和取消，核对后台及客户实际收到的消息。这是建议的验收场景，未经执行。开放收费名额前，应先确定取消与退款政策。

sections.en:
The downtime documentation separates entire non-working days, blocked slots inside a working day, and break time between services. Holidays and staff leave need a different configuration from the cleaning period after an appointment.

For example, a mobile instructor might need travel time after a lesson even when the next nominal slot falls inside normal working hours. Check both the customer-facing availability and the staff schedule after adding that break. A correct weekly timetable alone does not prove that date exceptions and travel buffers have been applied.
sections.zh:
停用时间文档区分整天不工作、工作日内封锁时段，以及服务之间的间隔。节假日和员工休假，与预约之后的清洁时间需要不同配置。

例如，上门授课的教师在一节课后可能需要路程时间，即使下个名义时段仍在正常营业时间内。设置间隔后，应核对客户看到的可用性与员工日程。每周时间表正确，并不能证明特殊日期与路程缓冲已生效。

sections.en:
The pricing view offers a 14-day trial and shows Lite, Regular and Premium at $50, $60 and $90 per month respectively. The read page uses a dollar symbol without an explicit currency code, so these amounts are not normalized to USD here. Annual discounts are advertised without a complete checkout total in the read view.

The key distinction is entitlement: Lite lists 10 services and 5 resources; Regular lists 40 and 20, with online payments through bookitPay only; Premium lists 200 and 100 and allows bookitPay or an own gateway. All three list unlimited bookings and staff accounts. Those unlimited quantities do not remove the service/resource ceilings. Confirm SMS, gateway fees, tax and setup costs in the quote.
sections.zh:
读取到的定价页提供 14 天试用，Lite、Regular、Premium 分别显示每月 $50、$60 和 $90。页面使用美元符号但未明确货币代码，本文不把它们统一换算为 USD。页面宣传年度折扣，但读取视图没有完整结算总额。

主要差别是权益：Lite 列出 10 项服务及 5 个资源；Regular 为 40 项及 20 个，在线付款仅使用 bookitPay；Premium 为 200 项及 100 个，可用 bookitPay 或自有网关。三档均列出预约次数和员工账户不限，但这不会取消服务及资源上限。短信、网关、税费和配置费用应在报价中确认。

sections.title_en: Prepare the business rules before signup
sections.en:
List the services to sell, resources to reserve, normal operating hours and exceptions. Then decide the booking form fields and the payment route. The vendor advertises optional setup assistance, so the published subscription should not be treated as proof that every implementation task is included.

Use the trial to check a sold-out class, a closed day and a changed booking. If a message does not arrive, compare the booking record with the message configuration rather than immediately creating another paid booking. Public pages do not document a universal automatic recovery policy; obtain the failure and support process for the selected service.
sections.zh:
先列出出售的服务、需要占用的资源、正常营业时间与例外，再决定预约表单字段和支付路径。厂商宣传可选配置协助，因此公开订阅价格不能证明所有实施工作已包含。

可利用试用核对满员班课、休息日和预约变更。若消息未到，应先比对预约记录与消息配置，不要立即重复创建付费预约。公开页面未给出通用自动恢复政策，应确认所选服务的故障与支持流程。

sections.en:
Training operators and service managers should evaluate whether their actual service/resource model fits the selected tier. A team seeking only a personal meeting link may not need the class and resource configuration. Conversely, a complex organization should ask about the Enterprise offer rather than extrapolating Premium limits.

The material read describes a managed online product. No self-hosting distribution or permissive software licence was verified. Integration availability, API scope and data-export completeness need separate confirmation before a migration decision.
sections.zh:
培训运营者和服务负责人，应核对实际服务及资源模型能否适配所选档位。只需要个人会议链接的团队，可能无需班课与资源配置；复杂组织则应询问 Enterprise，不能外推 Premium 上限。

已读材料介绍的是托管在线产品。未核实自托管发行版或宽松软件许可证。迁移决策前仍需单独确认集成可用性、API 范围和数据导出完整性。
